name: Complaint (Civil Pleading)
description: Civil complaint checked for the structural elements Rules 8, 9, 10, 11, and 38 require. Selects the PLDG-001..008 ruleset.
compliance_matrix_columns: Caption naming the court and all parties
Short and plain statement of the grounds for jurisdiction
Numbered paragraphs limited to a single set of circumstances
Rule 9(b) particularity for fraud or mistake
Jury demand where a jury is wanted
